newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia's Chilanga sales up 12.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Zambia's Chilanga sales up 12.5 percent.

text.p: Chilanga cement sales increased by 12.5 percent to 350,099 tonnes in 1996 with exports rising to a record 111,758 tonnes, a company official said on Thursday.
"Total sales in 1996 were 350,099 tonnes, an increase of 12.5 percent over 1995, and the best overall sales performance since 1992," the official said.

Sales earnings rose to 32.99 million kwacha ($25,000) from 20.027 million kwacha in 1995. The company's operating profit increased to 6.484 million kwacha from 3.358 million kwacha and its profit after tax to 3.518 million kwacha from 875 million kwacha.
Earnings per share increased to 17.59 kwacha from 4.37 kwacha.

"The directors are recommending the payment of a final dividend of 5.50 kwacha per ordinary share which, together with the interim dividend of 1.50 kwacha per share already paid, will bring the total dividend for 1996 to 7.00 kwacha per share," the official said.
The 1995 dividend was 2.00 kwacha per share.
